# Antis International Publisher

> A peer-reviewed open-access academic publishing platform hosting multidisciplinary journals spanning law, technology, geography, history, artificial intelligence, and medical sciences.

Antis International Publisher operates through the Open Journal Systems platform, publishing rigorous peer-reviewed research across six primary journals. The platform is based in Sidoarjo, Indonesia and serves the global scholarly community with open-access content under Creative Commons licensing.

## Key Topics

- peer-reviewed journals
- open-access publishing
- academic journals
- cyber law
- blockchain legal innovation

## Featured Journals

- [Journal of Contemporary Business Law & Technology: Cyber Law, Blockchain, and Legal Innovations](https://journal.antispublisher.id/index.php/EJCBLT): EJCBLT journal homepage covering cyber law, blockchain, and legal innovations in business technology
- [Journal of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Economy](https://journal.antispublisher.id/index.php/JAIDE): JAIDE journal for research on artificial intelligence applications and digital economy development
- [Journal of Medical Genetics and Clinical Biology](https://journal.antispublisher.id/index.php/JMGCB): JMGCB journal for medical genetics, clinical biology, and biomedical research
- [Journal of Higher Education and Academic Advancement](https://journal.antispublisher.id/index.php/EJHEAA): EJHEAA journal focused on higher education research, policy, and academic development
- [Journal of Geography, Regional Planning and Development](https://journal.antispublisher.id/index.php/JGRPD): JGRPD journal for geography, regional planning, and sustainable development research
- [Journal of Learning on History and Social Sciences](https://journal.antispublisher.id/index.php/EJLHSS): JLHSS journal for history, social sciences, and humanities research and education
